game.name: A Hat in Time
game.rules:
# **Verification Requirements**

- All runs must have a video. All videos must begin on the main menu, and must end with the collection of the last time piece or stamp in the run.
- **Runs must begin by creating and loading into a brand new file** (unless the category uses a premade save file). This means loading into an already created 0% file, or loading into a different file than the newly made one, are not permitted.
- You are required to use IGT (in game timer) to time your runs. Both built-in timers (Game Time and Level Time) are required to be enabled and must be visible in the recording at all times. All times submitted must be IGT only. 

# **General Game Rules**

- FPS (frames per second) must be capped at 60.
- Use of the developer console, or binds that run console commands, is not allowed during runs. 
- Certain cosmetic and QoL mods **are** allowed (check top of the guides page for a mod list). 
- To allow cosmetic and QoL mod use while maintaining competitive viability with DLC 2.1, the use of the community made "Unpatched Boop" tool is allowed on DLC 2 modded patches prior to the addition of the "Auto Jump" option in the game. (See the general game setup guide on the guides page to learn how to downpatch).
- The use of the community made "Timer Fix" tool to fix inconsistencies with the in game timers is allowed and encouraged.
- .ini editing for rebinding is allowed. Binds for making SDJ buttons are not allowed.
- Mash binds from external sources are banned. Mash binds derived purely from rebinding in the games .ini files are only allowed for textmashing, and scrolling *down* in menus. Only one button for each is permitted.
- .ini tweaks that change in-game graphical settings, as well as the ShadersOnDemand tweak and Vulkan are all allowed (texture detail and performance tweaks / timer placement).
- Exiting to desktop, main menu, or forcequitting is banned. Runs that crash are still able to be submitted with a time penalty (segment time at crash -1.2s).
- Any form of gameplay (menuing counts as well) with the game timer frozen is not allowed, with the exception of the post Finale credits menu **where you're only permitted to toggle the "No saving" option.**
- Any form of touch screen menuing is not allowed.
- You are not allowed to spawn in the co-op character during runs aside from in co-op categories. Online party must be disabled in all categories aside from those that use online co-op.
- If present, the "Live Game Events" option in Game Settings must be disabled. These events alter base game content (ex. the hub) and are only present for a temporary period of time, and have been disallowed to ensure available content remains consistent.

categories.name: 2 Character
categories.rules:
Collect the Time Piece as fast as possible. All general game rules are to be followed, unless otherwise is specified below.

The use of the co-op character OR online party functionaliy is allowed for this category. In case of an online party run, only two runners total may play, and both must record and upload their own perspective of the run. The additional video should be submitted in the Description field.

The speedrun act timer must be enabled and visible in the recording at all times.

The "restartIL" command from the Speedrun Tools mod, or Console Commands Plus mod, is allowed (and encouraged) for faster resets.

Use of unpatched boop is allowed, even on newer versions of the game.

If the IL is a Death Wish level, peace and tranquility is not allowed to be used.

The following restrictions apply to this category:

- All Badges except Hookshot are banned.
- Time Stop hat is banned.

- The use of Ultra Jumps (via the "Auto-Jump" option) is banned.

The speedrun act timer must be enabled and visible in the recording at all times.

The "restartIL" command from the Speedrun Tools mod, or Console Commands Plus mod, is allowed (and encouraged) for faster resets.

The speedrun act timer must be enabled and visible in the recording at all times.

The "restartIL" command from the Speedrun Tools mod, or Console Commands Plus mod, is allowed (and encouraged) for faster resets.

Use of unpatched boop is allowed, even on newer versions of the game.

If the IL is a Death Wish level, peace and tranquility is not allowed to be used.

---
Objective
---
Beat the game, collect all Time Pieces and Death Wish stamps as fast as possible!

The run begins after selecting yes on "Start new game." For this run, along with the main game time pieces, you must collect the five time pieces from Arctic Cruise, all ten in Nyakuza Metro, as well as the third spaceship rift. On top of this, you must collect all Death Wish stamps. Time ends on the collection of the last stamp or time piece needed, not the finale time piece cluster.

---
Category Specific Rules
---
- Returning to the main menu is inevitable due to tour only spawning after collecting 55 time pieces. Due to this, exiting to main menu during the credits cutscene after finale is allowed
- On DLC 2 patches, due to a bug where the timer resets upon first re-entry, an immediate save and quit is allowed to fix the IGT.
- IGT Restorer is allowed to alleviate the above bug.
- The usage of the slomo command to speed up the final game cutscene after collecting the Finale time piece is allowed.

categories.name: Co-op
categories.rules:
Co-op rules are exactly the same as the base game category rules. 

Local cooperative mode is to be submitted only in the "Local" subcategory, the rest of the subcategories are online party exclusive (2p, 3p, 4p and 5p+).

Runs must contain all perspectives linked, or edited into one video. The run is timed using RTA, and begins upon selecting "yes" to creating a new file.

Both in game timers (full game and act) are still required to be on at all times.

The mod "Online Party Super Syncing" and "Enhanced Join Act Menu" are allowed for use in this category.

ATP QOL patch and Unpatched Boop on CDLC 1 and current patches is allowed as long as Autojump is not used with it and Vanessa's Curse is not entered.

# Objective

Beat the game and collect all 40 of the base game Time Pieces as fast as possible!

The run begins after selecting yes on "Start new game", and ends when you collect the last 40th base game time piece.

# Category Specific Rules

- Entering DLC levels is not permitted in this run.
- Exiting to main menu during the credits cutscene after The Finale is allowed.
- On DLC 2 patches, due to a bug where the timer resets upon file first re-entry, an immediate save and quit once the run starts is allowed to fix the IGT.
- IGT Restorer is allowed to fix the above bug.
- The usage of the slomo command to speed up the final game cutscene after collecting the The Finale time piece is allowed.
- The use of DLC 2 w/ mods with patching tools such as "Boop" and "ATP QoL" is allowed.

You know, it's really funny. I started running this game on/off since 2020 with sub-40 as my main goal, and I struggled to get it. This was in the lag abuse category before lagless became a thing.

Then in February 2024, I finally managed to get sub 40, and I felt relieved. I think I kept getting stressed out because I like to put high expectations on myself, so the fact that I was struggling this much to get a time everyone was able to get relatively easily made me feel like I was just outright bad.

I took a whole year break after that, and honestly, I didn't expect to come back to the game. But my interest grew and I thought I'd give it a go. Within a week of derusting, I managed to get a 20-second PB, and the day after (today), I managed to make ANOTHER 40-SECOND PB. I never thought I'd reach 38, so this is a cool time. It's also weird to think that certain levels have so much time loss that I could probably get to a high 37 with some learning.

Anyway, I'm happy with this time, and I'd be satisfied if I never got another PB, although I'll try my best to ensure that doesn't happen.

categories.name: Any%
categories.rules:
Collect the Time Piece as fast as possible. All general game rules are to be followed, unless otherwise is specified below.

The speedrun act timer must be enabled and visible in the recording at all times.

The "restartIL" command from the Speedrun Tools mod, or Console Commands Plus mod, is allowed (and encouraged) for faster resets.

Use of unpatched boop is allowed, even on newer versions of the game.

If the IL is a Death Wish level, peace and tranquility is not allowed to be used.

games.name: A Hat in Time
games.rules:
# **Verification Requirements**

- All runs must have a video. All videos must begin on the main menu, and must end with the collection of the last time piece or stamp in the run.
- **Runs must begin by creating and loading into a brand new file** (unless the category uses a premade save file). This means loading into an already created 0% file, or loading into a different file than the newly made one, are not permitted.
- You are required to use IGT (in game timer) to time your runs. Both built-in timers (Game Time and Level Time) are required to be enabled and must be visible in the recording at all times. All times submitted must be IGT only. 

# **General Game Rules**

- FPS (frames per second) must be capped at 60.
- Use of the developer console, or binds that run console commands, is not allowed during runs. 
- Certain cosmetic and QoL mods **are** allowed (check top of the guides page for a mod list). 
- To allow cosmetic and QoL mod use while maintaining competitive viability with DLC 2.1, the use of the community made "Unpatched Boop" tool is allowed on DLC 2 modded patches prior to the addition of the "Auto Jump" option in the game. (See the general game setup guide on the guides page to learn how to downpatch).
- The use of the community made "Timer Fix" tool to fix inconsistencies with the in game timers is allowed and encouraged.
- .ini editing for rebinding is allowed. Binds for making SDJ buttons are not allowed.
- Mash binds from external sources are banned. Mash binds derived purely from rebinding in the games .ini files are only allowed for textmashing, and scrolling *down* in menus. Only one button for each is permitted.
- .ini tweaks that change in-game graphical settings, as well as the ShadersOnDemand tweak and Vulkan are all allowed (texture detail and performance tweaks / timer placement).
- Exiting to desktop, main menu, or forcequitting is banned. Runs that crash are still able to be submitted with a time penalty (segment time at crash -1.2s).
- Any form of gameplay (menuing counts as well) with the game timer frozen is not allowed, with the exception of the post Finale credits menu **where you're only permitted to toggle the "No saving" option.**
- Any form of touch screen menuing is not allowed.
- You are not allowed to spawn in the co-op character during runs aside from in co-op categories. Online party must be disabled in all categories aside from those that use online co-op.
- If present, the "Live Game Events" option in Game Settings must be disabled. These events alter base game content (ex. the hub) and are only present for a temporary period of time, and have been disallowed to ensure available content remains consistent.

levels.name: Death Wish - Rift Collapse - Sleepy Subcon

runs.comment:
You know, it's really funny. I started running this game on/off since 2020 with sub-40 as my main goal, and I struggled to get it. This was in the lag abuse category before lagless became a thing.

Then in February 2024, I finally managed to get sub 40, and I felt relieved. I think I kept getting stressed out because I like to put high expectations on myself, so the fact that I was struggling this much to get a time everyone was able to get relatively easily made me feel like I was just outright bad.

I took a whole year break after that, and honestly, I didn't expect to come back to the game. But my interest grew and I thought I'd give it a go. Within a week of derusting, I managed to get a 20-second PB, and the day after (today), I managed to make ANOTHER 40-SECOND PB. I never thought I'd reach 38, so this is a cool time. It's also weird to think that certain levels have so much time loss that I could probably get to a high 37 with some learning.

Anyway, I'm happy with this time, and I'd be satisfied if I never got another PB, although I'll try my best to ensure that doesn't happen.
